source.packaging_scope: Stable problem/dataset identity, operational feedback definitions, native-checkout regression coverage, PASS-first instruction clarification, and descriptive judge metadata only; evaluator, reference, workload assets, runtime recipes, and policy limits unchanged. Historical image/source identities and measurements are not rebound.

notes: Beat spec v3 (science revision f700b9d4): inference_latency_ms (strict, paired protocol) joins the verdict and the candidate-only feedback; the continuous score is unchanged.

Release refresh 2026-10-11: reconciled with the candidate-rejection verdict fix on main (verifier/fcs2_verifier.py is main's); the sentence claiming a score after every submission is corrected; limits unchanged (900 s); the added work is estimated under 3 s per verification; not GPU-validated.

Numerical validation also runs under the conditions of both timed blocks: every warmup and timed repeat of the paired training and inference protocols uses new input values (identical for candidate and reference within a repeat), and every candidate call is compared with the reference implementation holding the candidate's trained state, run through the same block function on that repeat's values.

Workload count, gate, score, batch shape, repeat counts, pairing order, policy and limits (900 s) unchanged; the timed input values are drawn anew per repeat from the workload's validation photographs. Files changed against the beat-spec-v3 source: agent-base/frontier/task/repo/README.md, judge/beat_spec.json, judge/evaluator.py, judge/readme. fp16 tolerances and the added time (ESTIMATE about 4-5 s per verification) are not GPU-validated.

Gradient validation revised 2026-10-12: the candidate's timed-block gradients are no longer required to be near the reference's own fp16 gradient (an honest all-fp16 formulation failed that on the L4 by up to 15.5x). Per training repeat the oracle supplies three trusted gradients (reference under autocast, reference with all-fp16 sites, fp32) and the candidate must be within floor + 3 x their spread of the nearest, jointly and per group. Outputs and loss tolerances, gate, workloads, score, schedule, policy and limits (900 s) unchanged. Floors are provisional until task_tests/dynamic_tanh/calibrate_timed_path.py has been run on the L4; not GPU-validated. Files changed: agent-base/frontier/task/repo/README.md, judge/beat_spec.json, judge/evaluator.py, judge/readme.

Rejection category 2026-10-12: a timed-path rejection appends one fixed category (training or inference block; first failing quantity) to the evaluator message; no value, threshold, workload or repeat. Validation, constants, gate, workloads, score, policy and limits unchanged. Files changed: agent-base/frontier/task/repo/README.md, judge/evaluator.py, judge/readme.

Rejection diagnostic 2026-10-12: a rejected development submission returns metrics.candidate_diagnostic (stage; for the timed-path validation also block and first failing quantity; fixed table, validated by judge/candidate_failure.py pinned in judge/candidate-diagnostic.json) through the verifier's existing declared channel; declared in beat_spec solver_feedback and solver_visible_metrics. Final responses, validation, constants, gate, workloads, score and limits unchanged. Files changed or added: agent-base/frontier/task/README.md, agent-base/frontier/task/repo/README.md, judge/beat_spec.json, judge/candidate-diagnostic.json, judge/candidate_failure.py, judge/config.yaml, judge/evaluator.py, judge/readme, policy.json.

L4 calibration 2026-10-12 and decision: with the trusted set reference-fp16, all-fp16, fp32 and factor 3, all attacks met the rejection rule and one honest fused fp16 variant reached 0.696 of the bound on the largest-spread repeat (required margin 0.67). The fused all-fp16 form joins the trusted set (four trusted gradients); factor 3 and floors unchanged; decided after one run and to be confirmed by two further L4 calibration runs before publication. Gate, workloads, score, policy and limits unchanged. Files changed: agent-base/frontier/task/repo/README.md, judge/beat_spec.json, judge/evaluator.py, judge/readme.
